dailyProofCycleCompletion.note: The daily-proof test-project cycle (section 3), demonstrated end to end. Distinct from spec148CandidatePublicationGate, which is this Spec 148 candidate's own human-only publication gate. The deterministic harness drives Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution with the real services; only the ImplementerRuntimeProvider process spawn is the injectable adapter (section 23). Terminal completion IS reached and is truthful, not fabricated: the ADOS run reports run-level completion (execution.evidence.completed true - distinct from ImplementerRuntimeStatus 'Completed', which is only 'subprocess exited'), production's deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus then derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 policy's active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' through the existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput transition. No production code performs an autonomous in_progress -> completed jump and none is added.

spec148CandidatePublicationGate.note: THIS Spec 148 candidate's own review/validation/publication gate - distinct from dailyProofCycleCompletion. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion are human-only per execution policy and are not performed by the implementer runtime, so every field below is correctly pending/false at implementation handoff. ADOS runs full configured validation and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD after handoff; this artifact does not freeze that verdict because committing it advances HEAD. The in-office ADOS records cannot represent the publish/merge/deploy legs at all: Spec 130 types validationStarted/reviewStarted/repositoryMutationStarted/githubMutationStarted/publishStarted/mergeStarted/deployStarted as the literal false (src/features/city-view/scene/office/external-ados-execution/ExternalProjectAdosExecutionTypes.ts:41-47, src/features/city-view/scene/office/external-ados-run-status/ExternalProjectAdosRunStatusTypes.ts:29-35), and Spec 148 adds no production code, so surfacing publication in-office would require a Spec 130 schema change - an explicit non-goal. Live verdict: shaAlignment.durableSources, gated by tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. They are durably available in the sources below and resolved at validation/review time, not transcribed here: a SHA literal committed into a tracked file is stale the moment the commit lands (it changes HEAD). tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads those durable sources and, in a populated run dir, requires validation-runtime.json and review-runtime.json to be present (a selectively-deleted sibling fails, not skips). It asserts durableCandidate.candidate_sha === `git rev-parse HEAD` unconditionally (candidate.json is written for the exact commit before validation runs, so this leg has no pipeline-order circularity), asserts validation left the worktree unmutated (head_before === head_after), then compares candidate/validated/reviewed targets against exact HEAD with the SAME comparator production uses - validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached in production through validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage - and feeds that DERIVED exactTargetMatch plus the REAL durable review decision into computeConvergenceStatus, asserting it converges iff an Approved review is aligned on all three SHAs. On every cycle after the first, review-runtime.json (and briefly validation-runtime.json) still names the prior finished candidate; the derivation then yields exactTargetMatch=false and the assertion is 'must not authorize publication' - a real invariant on both branches, and no self-destruct.
shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate, and runSummary.js feeds the same derived value into computeConvergenceStatus as exactTargetMatch. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts cross-checks the same three durable SHAs with the same targetsMatch comparator against `git rev-parse HEAD`.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied + validationPolicy.js targetsMatch (production exact-HEAD gate at orchestrateCommand.js final-verification) and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus; exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and the durable-source candidate == validated == reviewed cross-check via targetsMatch against exact HEAD

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). Concerns the Spec 148 candidate's own publication (spec148CandidatePublicationGate), a separate human-only gate from the dailyProofCycleCompletion cycle above, which Test X demonstrates reaching a truthful terminal 'completed' state. Not reached at implementation handoff. This is a standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.
